name: Scarecrow

source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual has a newer block that isn't in SRD 5.2.1; this one keeps the 2014 numbers until it can be checked against the book. Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual scarecrow; the 2024 block isn't entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Its resistance to nonmagical weapons is entered as plain resistance. The AI doesn't pick Terrifying Glare yet (it uses save actions only with a recharge or in a Multiattack).

languages: understands its creator's languages but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.summary: Looks like an ordinary scarecrow while it stays still.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: A raking claw; a creature hit makes a DC 11 Wis save or is Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.summary: DC 11 Wis save by a creature within 30 ft that can see it, or Frightened and Paralyzed until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.

summary: A straw figure brought to malevolent life: frightening claws and a stare that roots victims in place. Burns easily.
